scripts.lint: pnpm --filter api lint && pnpm --filter web lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter api typecheck && pnpm --filter web typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @repo/shared-types build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: pnpm --dir apps/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.ci: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
